title: PackManifest
description: Immutable per-version pack manifest, matching Kotlin PackManifest(schemaVersion, minReaderVersion, id, version, language, title, objective, publication, phrases[], lessons[], assets[], credits[]=[]). schemaVersion/minReaderVersion gate client compatibility explicitly; publication (a plain "development"|"published" string enum, matching Kotlin PublicationStatus) governs what the public catalog may reference. There is no nested revision on publication: pack-level versioning lives in 'version' and lesson-level versioning lives in each Lesson's own 'revision' field, never duplicated here. Total serialized size must stay <= 4 MiB (manifest JSON ceiling) and the pack's assets must together respect the 256-asset / 20 MiB-per-asset / 50 MiB-total ceilings enforced by the builder, not by this schema alone.

publication.description: Matches Kotlin PublicationStatus. No 'retired' value here -- retirement is an install-time/catalog concept (CatalogEntry.retired, Room InstalledPackStatus.RETIRED), never an editorial content state on the manifest itself.
